Fact.Name: This Form 1099-DA is a received statement, complete safe
Fact.Description: False only when the VOID box is answered checked; true when VOID is unchecked or unanswered (Copy B, the recipient's copy, prints no VOID box, so an unanswered VOID is the ordinary case). Read by the three Form 1099-DA refusals, which ignore a voided copy.

Fact.Name: This Form 1099-DA's box 4 federal income tax withheld, or zero
Fact.Description: Box 4, Federal income tax withheld, on this Form 1099-DA with cents intact, when this is a received statement and box 4 is answered; zero when box 4 is unanswered, when the copy is VOID, and for a negative answer (the Min $0 limit on the writable is not enforced when a fact resolves, so the floor is here). No per-document rounding: /form1099DaFederalIncomeTaxWithheld sums these and Form 1040 line 25b rounds its total once.

Fact.Name: This Form 1099-DA shows creator first-sale proceeds, complete safe
Fact.Description: True when this is a received statement and box 11c, the aggregate gross proceeds attributable to first sales of specified NFTs the recipient created or minted, is answered with an amount above zero. Unanswered or zero is false. Read by /knockoutForm1099DaCreatorFirstSaleProceedsNotRouted.

Fact.Name: At least one received Form 1099-DA is entered
Fact.Description: True when the Form 1099-DA list is complete and holds at least one item that is not a VOID copy. An absent or empty list is false.

Fact.Name: At least one Form 8949 transaction is marked as reported on a Form 1099-DA
Fact.Description: True when the Form 8949 transaction list is complete and at least one item answers that the broker reported it on a Form 1099-DA (../reportedOnForm1099DA, the box G, H, J and K leg). Complements /hasDigitalAssetForm8949Transactions, which reads the separate digital-asset flag: a row marked reported on a Form 1099-DA but not flagged digital still lands in box G, H, J or K.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-DA entered with no digital asset disposition reported
Fact.Description: You entered a Form 1099-DA, but the return reports no digital asset sale or exchange: there is no Form 8949 transaction marked as a digital asset or as reported on a Form 1099-DA, and no Schedule D line 1a or line 8a total. A Form 1099-DA reports proceeds of a disposition you generally must report on Form 8949 (boxes G through L) or directly on Schedule D line 1a or 8a. Enter each transaction the form reports, or remove the form if it was entered by mistake. A VOID copy does not refuse. A Schedule D line 1a or 8a total is accepted as reporting the disposition because those lines combine Form 1099-B and Form 1099-DA transactions; the return does not reconcile the amounts.

Fact.Name: Total Form 1099-DA box 4 federal income tax withheld
Fact.Description: Sum of box 4 backup withholding over every received Form 1099-DA on the return, with cents intact: an addend of the Form 1040 line 25b total, taxCalculations:/form1099Withholding, which rounds once. A VOID copy adds nothing. No filer filter, as the Form 1099-B total /form1099BFederalIncomeTaxWithheld: the return's Schedule D reports every digital asset disposition it lists. A Form 8949 row marked as reported on a Form 1099-DA carries no Form 1099-B box 4 (/form8949Transactions/*/form1099BFederalWithholdingOrZero), so the same withholding is not counted from both surfaces. An absent or empty list contributes zero.

Fact.Name: Form 1099-DA creator first-sale proceeds cannot be reported
Fact.Description: A Form 1099-DA you entered shows, in box 11c, gross proceeds from the first sale of specified NFTs you created or minted. Those proceeds are not in box 1f and are not a Form 8949 disposition; this return cannot yet decide where that income is reported, so it cannot be filed here.

Fact.Name: This installment sale's short-term gain on Schedule D line 4
Fact.Description: Form 6252 line 26 plus line 37 when the sale files Form 6252 and its destination is capitalShortTerm or personalUseShortTerm; $0 otherwise; Incomplete for a positive amount with no destination.

Fact.Name: This installment sale's long-term gain on Schedule D line 11
Fact.Description: Form 6252 line 26 plus line 37 when the sale files Form 6252 and its destination is capitalLongTerm or personalUseLongTerm; $0 otherwise; Incomplete for a positive amount with no destination.

Fact.Name: This exchange's short-term gain or loss on Schedule D line 4
Fact.Description: Form 8824 line 22 when its destination is a short-term capital or personal-use option and the installment method does not apply, plus line 14 when its destination is capitalShortTerm (gain or loss) or personalUseShortTerm (a gain only; a personal-use loss is not deductible). $0 otherwise; Incomplete when a needed answer is missing.

Fact.Name: This exchange's long-term gain or loss on Schedule D line 11
Fact.Description: Form 8824 line 22 when its destination is a long-term capital or personal-use option and the installment method does not apply, plus line 14 when its destination is capitalLongTerm (gain or loss) or personalUseLongTerm (a gain only). $0 otherwise; Incomplete when a needed answer is missing.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 4: the Form 6252 and Form 8824 short-term amounts
Fact.Description: The short-term Form 6252 gains and Form 8824 gains or losses this return carries to Schedule D line 4, summed over the sales and exchanges that file their form. Complete-safe $0 on a return with neither form. An addend of /scheduleDLine4ShortTermGainFromOtherForms, so it reaches the printed line 4 and line 7.

Fact.Name: Schedule D line 11: the Form 6252 and Form 8824 long-term amounts
Fact.Description: The long-term Form 6252 gains and Form 8824 gains or losses this return carries to Schedule D line 11, summed over the sales and exchanges that file their form. Complete-safe $0 on a return with neither form. An addend of the printed line 11 (/scheduleDLine11GainFromForm4797AndOtherForms) and of line 15 (/longTermGainOrLossAfterCarryover).
